text:
anne_support: Heads up — customer reports checkout returned success and email shows promo applied, but subaccount balance stayed 0. Tenant: acme-marketing / subacct 9876. Stripe webhook got 200. Can billing team triage?

jordan_engineer: Can you paste the webhook payload and the order id? quick check: sometimes grant lands on parent billing_profile instead of the subaccount.

anne_support: payload below (redacted):
```json
{
  "event": "promotion.redeemed",
  "code": "ACME-TRIAL-2026",
  "external_id": "tok_abc123",
  "org_id": "12345",
  "subaccount_id": "9876",
  "status": "accepted",
  "webhook_status": 200
}
```

anne_support: Customer email: promo@acme.com, created at 2239876520. UI shows green check and "promo applied". Balance still 0 when they query usage API and on billing portal.

maya_billing: Thanks — I see the webhook arrived and our ingestion created a grant record, but grant.owner_type = \"org\" and owner_id = 12345 (parent org) rather than owner_type = \"subaccount\" / owner_id = 9876. Looks like the tenant-side mapping didn't pick the subaccount param.

jordan_engineer: Possible causes: 1) frontend sent subaccount_id in a different field (metadata) so webhook parser ignored it, or 2) the grant-apply worker matched by external_id to an existing parent grant and did not reopen mapping. Can you share the ingest log lines for external_id tok_abc123?

anne_support: ingest log snippet: 
```
[2239876531] INFO grant_ingest: external_id=tok_abc123 org=12345 subaccount=null matched_existing=true applied_to=org
```

maya_billing: OK — the worker set subaccount=null because the webhook parser only pulls subaccount_id from payload.subaccount_id (we recently added support for metadata.subacct). The customer is sending subaccount_id in payload.metadata.subacct (legacy checkout).

jordan_engineer: That explains it. Two action items: 1) billing team can run a one-off fix to move the grant from org 12345 -> subaccount 9876 for this external_id, and 2) ops/ingest team needs a small parser update to look in metadata.subacct as a fallback.

maya_billing: I'll perform the manual fix now and open INC-3456 to track the parser patch.

billing-bot: Incident INC-3456 created by maya_billing: "promo grants: fallback to metadata.subacct and reapply existing grants to correct owner when applicable". Priority P2.

maya_billing: Manual fix completed at 2239876880 — ledger entry moved, customer subaccount balance updated to $150 (trial credit) and usage API now returns non-zero. Repro steps for QA: run ingestion on a test webhook with metadata.subacct and confirm grant.owner_type=subaccount. I'll follow up with a PR for parser change and a post-deploy smoke test.

anne_support: Awesome — forwarded resolution to customer, they confirmed balance updated. Leaving this thread open until parser patch is merged. :thumbsup:

jordan_engineer: I'll pick up the parser patch. ETA EOD. Thanks for the quick triage!
